{"metadata":{"description":"DSH plugin for agent-driven span compaction: compress chosen conversation spans into self-written checkpoints instead of the official head-anchored full-context sweep.","id":"gh:1333877597","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-agent-compact","slug":"MimicHunterZ/dsh-agent-compact","topics":["context-compression","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DSH plugin for agent-driven span compaction: compress chosen conversation spans into self-written ch"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"eckpoints instead of the official head-anchored full-context sweep."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# agent-compact"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English · 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Context compression for DeepSeek Harness: lets the **agent autonomously call** `context_compact` to "},{"id":"p4s2","text":"compress a span of the conversation it chooses — the finished, no-longer-needed middle — and replace"},{"id":"p4s3","text":" it with a checkpoint the agent writes itself."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Why"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Compaction is normally a full-context sweep: the official engine only ever compresses from the start"},{"id":"p6s2","text":" of the conversation, so the opening's task plan and direction are **partially lost along with the c"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"ompressed information**. `context_compact` compresses **only the span the agent selects** — a finish"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"ed step, a debugged log exchange, an off-track discussion — while the important opening and the rece"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"nt context stay intact. Span compaction keeps **information loss from compaction as small as possibl"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"e** — like human memory, the middle is not compressed indiscriminately: what can be summarized is co"},{"id":"p6s7","text":"nsolidated into a checkpoint, and important details stay word-for-word — the agent decides what is t"},{"id":"p6s8","text":"ruly dead, and only that gets condensed."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Typical moments to use it:"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- a task step is done — compress it, keep the remaining steps and the active instruction live;
- a b"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"ug hunt or a wrong research direction is over — compress that exchange into a short "what went wrong"},{"id":"p8s3","text":" / root cause / fix" note;
- the opening requirements are stale — compress the start and restate the"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"fix" note;
- the opening requirements are stale — compress the start and restate the current intent."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## What it does"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- The agent picks the span via `startAnchor` / `endAnchor` (unique-prefix matching, CJK punctuation-"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"width tolerant) and passes a **required** `summary` — the Markdown checkpoint it wrote itself.
- The"},{"id":"p10s3","text":" raw span is archived to the spill store first (`~/.dsh/spill/session-<hash>/<hex>-<seq>.txt`, seque"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"ntial naming, restart-safe); the path is echoed in the shadow message so the model can read the raw "},{"id":"p10s5","text":"text back.
- The host engine runs the stock transaction — boundary validation, tool-pair balance, su"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"rface replacement — with **no separate LLM summarizer request**."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"The tool call itself happens inside the agent's normal turn and is billed like any other turn; what "},{"id":"p11s2","text":"is avoided is only the *extra* summarizer request the official engine would make for the same span."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"`dsh plugin` forwards to pnpm in the profile directory and appends the bundle to `dsh.profile.bundle"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"s` (see the official publish guide). **Restart the profile** — every session then sees the `context_"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"ficial publish guide). **Restart the profile** — every session then sees the `context_compact` tool."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"The bundle's own `cordis.patch.yml` pins the spill archive root to `~/.dsh/spill` (deployments can o"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"verride it again through the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`)."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Uninstall"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"`dsh plugin remove` forwards to `pnpm remove` in the profile directory: it uninstalls the package an"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"d reconciles the bundle out of `dsh.profile.bundles`. **Restart the profile** — every session then s"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"tops seeing the `context_compact` tool. The same package name works whether you installed from the r"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"egistry or from a local checkout."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"If the plugin was additionally mounted through a row in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (dev mode),"},{"id":"p19s2","text":" remove that row too, otherwise the patch re-mounts it on the next boot."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| field | default | meaning |"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"| `autoArchive` | `true` | `context_compact` saves the full raw span to a spill artifact before repl"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"acing it |
| `volumeNudgeTokens` | `50000` | Every time accumulated surface growth (heuristic token "},{"id":"p22s3","text":"count) since the last compaction crosses another multiple of this amount, remind the model to consid"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"er `context_compact`. `0` disables the nudge. |"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Pass through the inserted row in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` or a bundle patch."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- **Agent-written checkpoint**: `summary` is mandatory, so the tool path always uses the checkpoint "},{"id":"p25s2","text":"the agent wrote. `patchEngine()` (see `src/optimizer.ts`) wraps the engine's `summarize()`: when an "},{"id":"p25s3","text":"`_externalSummary` is present (one-shot, keyed per session id), it returns that text directly; only "},{"id":"p25s4","text":"when none is present does it forward to the stock implementation — a branch that serves the automati"},{"id":"p25s5","text":"c compaction path and keeps official behavior intact.
- **System-prompt guidance**: the bundle regis"},{"id":"p25s6","text":"ters a global prompt section (`tool:context_compact`, order 118) that tells the agent to use `contex"},{"id":"p25s7","text":"t_compact` proactively — compress finished steps at topic boundaries instead of waiting for automati"},{"id":"p25s8","text":"c full-context compaction.
- **Proactive volume nudge**: a `systemPrompt.context()` injection (`agen"},{"id":"p25s9","text":"t-compact:volume-nudge`, order 50) reminds the model once each time the session's surface has grown "},{"id":"p25s10","text":"by another `volumeNudgeTokens` (default `50000`) multiple since the last compaction. It measures occ"},{"id":"p25s11","text":"upancy via `contextPressure.projectedTokens` (falling back to `tokenMeter.measure().surfaceTokens`);"},{"id":"p25s12","text":" the growth baseline resets on every `compaction/summary`; `0` disables it. As a tail `systemPrompt."},{"id":"p25s13","text":"context()`, unchanged text is a no-op (KV-cache friendly) and it is independent of the auto-compacto"},{"id":"p25s14","text":"r's pressure threshold.
- **Anchor matching** (`src/normalize.ts`): `normText` collapses whitespace "},{"id":"p25s15","text":"and maps CJK full-width punctuation to half-width (，→, etc.), applied to both anchors and node text."},{"id":"p25s16","text":" Matching keeps **unique-prefix** semantics: zero hits → "not found" with closest-node hints; more t"},{"id":"p25s17","text":"han one hit → "AMBIGUOUS".
- **Restart-safe sequential archives**: the next number is derived by sca"},{"id":"p25s18","text":"nning the session's spill directory (`max+1`) — gap-free; the backend's random hex prefix makes file"},{"id":"p25s19","text":"name collisions impossible.
- **Paired cleanup**: the tool-call message (carrying the full `summary`"},{"id":"p25s20","text":" argument) and its tool/result are each replaced by one tiny shadow message, so the checkpoint text "},{"id":"p25s21","text":"never appears twice on the surface (skipped when the message holds more than one tool call).
